summary: NOVA LTD. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting record first-quarter 2026 financial results. Revenue was $235.3 million, GAAP EPS $2.04, non-GAAP EPS $2.33. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 2.02. No special-situation event is present.
